usage: 手機 (sau2 gei1) is a noun, used to refer to a mobile phone or cellphone.
You can use 手機 in sentences as the subject or object, for example, 'I bought a new phone' or 'My phone is charging.'
When talking about using or having a phone, you can say 我有手機 (I have a phone) or 我用手機 (I use a phone).
手機 can be combined with verbs like 開 (on), 關 (off), 拍 (take a photo with), or 打 (make a call on).
You can also use 手機 in questions, for example: 你有手機嗎？ (Do you have a phone?).
